episodes.synopsis: Student Kakeru Todoroki learns he is a chosen driver to fight off Xenon and is given his Gyrozetter Raibird.
episodes.title: Raibird to the Front

episodes.synopsis: Kakeru learns more about the secrets behind the Arcadian school and Gyrozetters. Kakeru's friend Rinne is revealed to be the second chosen driver.
episodes.title: The Secret of Rosettagraphy

episodes.synopsis: The Acradian leaders continue to decipher who the third driver is. Kakeru believes Michie is the third driver but is later revealed to be Racing Superstar Hayami Shunsuke.
episodes.title: The Magnificent Third Driver!

episodes.synopsis: Shunsuke and Kakeru butt heads and race to see who is better. Xenon spies on them to gather more information on the Arcadian Gyrozetters.
episodes.title: Showdown! Racing Battle!

episodes.synopsis: Kakeru, Rinne and Shunsuke head out for team training. Meanwhile Xenon unleashes their trump card, Eraser-01 and Guiltice to destroy Kakeru.
episodes.title: Appearance! Eraser-01!

episodes.synopsis: While the team is away on from their school, Xenon's attacks their Arcadia Headquarters. Kakeru and Shunsuke fight Eraser at the Mount Fuji, while Rinne must rush back and rescue the city. Michie is revealed to be the fourth chosen driver.
episodes.title: Clash! Raibird vs Guiltice!

episodes.synopsis: Xenon's Haruka infiltrates Arcadia's school disguised as the fifth driver, Satori, in order to steal information on the Moebius engines. Meanwhile the real Satori tries to find her way to the school.
episodes.title: Satori the Transfer Student

episodes.synopsis: AI Cars begin to drive off on their own. The Chosen drivers set out to investigate.
episodes.title: Dash! Disappearing AI Cars!

episodes.synopsis: Kakeru's Gyro Commander goes missing and blames Xenon for its disappearance.
episodes.title: The Stolen Gyro Commander

episodes.synopsis: the town holds a festival showcasing the Gyrozetters and introducing the public to the chosen drivers. Eraser-01 attacks the festival in the upgraded Guiltice Extreme. Raibird is defeated.
episodes.title: Guiltice Returns

episodes.synopsis: With Raibird in repairs from the prevois episode, Kakeru tries to keep himself busy. Xenon attempts to infiltrate the Arcadia base to steal Raibird's Moebius Engine.
episodes.title: A Day without Raibird

episodes.synopsis: Eraser-01 attempts to destroy the Rosettagraphy but is stopped by Kakeru and the upgraded Raibird. The Arcadia TV crew investigates EnelX about a mysterious sea monster and is lured into a Xenon trap.
episodes.title: Complete! Raibird Hyper Spec

episodes.synopsis: The Chosen Drivers face off aginst Touma and the gigantic Gyrozetters Draganos and Great Kraken. Prius Alpha is destroyed.
episodes.title: The Nightmare of Great Kraken

episodes.synopsis: Mic-Man Seki and the rest of the TV Arcadia crew make a special on the Gyrozetters and their chosen drivers. Meanwhile we learn that Eraser-01 is the 6th chosen driver Souta Gunji being forcibly brainwashed by Xenon.
episodes.title: Hyper Speed Special

episodes.synopsis: Haruka attempts to steal the Gyrozetter Dolphine. Rinnie and Kakeru have a fight. Dolphine is presented to Rinne as a replacement while Prius Alpha is in repairs.
episodes.title: Nice to Meet You, Dolphine!

episodes.synopsis: Mic-man falls helplessly in love with Saki. Rinne forces Kakeru to help make sure Saki and Mic-man's date goes alright.
episodes.title: A Mic-man's Love

episodes.synopsis: Rinne, Kakeru and Michie help the class president find her father, famous wrestler Devil III. Touma tries out the new Gyrozetter model on Raibird.
episodes.title: Roaring! Death Match!

episodes.synopsis: Everyone tries to keep Kakeru from eating chocolate. The Gryozetters are sent out to catch a giant container full of chocolate. Haruka uses Xenon's new eK Wagon to try to give Shunsuke chocolate.
episodes.title: An Exciting Valentine

episodes.synopsis: The chosen drivers help escort a panda to the Zoo. Xenon attempts to steal said panda. The Gyrozetter Patrol Team is introduced.
episodes.title: A Panda Comes To Town

episodes.synopsis: Michie and Kakeru try out on a Comedy Show in hopes of becoming famous comedians. Xenon takes the chance to attack the Headquarters.
episodes.title: Birth of the Comedy Hero!

episodes.synopsis: Kakeru and Shunsuke compete in a Rally Car Race. Xenon attempts to get them disqualified to allow Touma to win.
episodes.title: Let's Go! Smash out the Rally!

episodes.synopsis: Satori tries to become a mature person. Haruka tries to steal important documents from Akana.
episodes.title: Satori! The Shot of a Pledge!

episodes.synopsis: The TV Arcadia Crew investigate mysterious incidents of data being wiped. Kakeru's father tries to remember something important.
episodes.title: The Eraser Corps Appear!

episodes.synopsis: Satori's charm begins to tell her about the future. Shunsuke searches for the traitor. Rinne must protect the Gyro Ark from the Eraser Corps.
episodes.title: Soar! Triple Twist Jump!

episodes.synopsis: Shunsuke's suspicions of a traitor in Arcadia are confirmed when a bomb is planted on the Gyro Ark in mid-air.
episodes.title: The Gyro Ark's Close Call!

episodes.synopsis: When the traitor is revealed and Commander Hisaishi kidnapped, Arcadia rushes to prepare a new type of Gyrozetter to rescue him.
episodes.title: RRR Awakens! Secret of the Burst Core

episodes.synopsis: Saki prepares a report on the events that have transpired so far, and rejoins her colleagues.
episodes.title: The Saki from the future

episodes.synopsis: The final showdown between Kakeru and Eraser-01 brings forth memories of the past and a revelation.
episodes.title: Guiltice's Challenge

episodes.synopsis: New foes appear as Arcadia looks to rescue Gunji Souta from Xenon.
episodes.title: Sunset Lightning Slash

episodes.synopsis: As Souta settles in to life at Arcadia, another giant Xenon Gyrozetter attacks Arcadia to retrieve him.
episodes.title: A Desperate Situation! Raibird

episodes.synopsis: Transported to a unthinkable future, Kakeru and Rinne encounter new friends and some familiar faces.
episodes.title: The Shining Edition Prophecy

episodes.synopsis: After returning home, Kakeru and Rinne find that a week has passed and things have changed at Arcadia.
episodes.title: Roar! Moebius Overdrive!
Cats, Fireworks and the Summer Festival
It Began Under the Shooting Stars
Defeat Albaros, the Wings of Despair!
A Mysterious Night in a Mysterious City
Dangerous Summer Vacation on a Southern Island
Start of the Arcadia Grand Prix!
Final Showdown at the Arcadia Grand Prix!
An Excellent Day for Filming! Who's the Hero?
To Haruka of the Distant Future
Race Towards the Future! Kakeru and Raibird!
